note: Contaminated mineral soil/rock (17 05 03*, high metals) does not fit here on composition grounds — inorganic content doesn't combust. This facility is for the organic/combustible waste stream. `mineralMatrixExclusion` is a Norwegian-only term list: a matrix type not written in Norwegian (e.g. Italian 'Terra e rocce' = soil and rock) will not be caught by a substring match here even if it is genuinely mineral. The matching logic in lib/hp-classification/facility-match.ts therefore treats any matrix string outside this vocabulary as unassessable ('insufficient data') rather than assuming it is safely non-mineral.
